title: Base change of the transpose of a unit-valued trace
statement:
Use the finite coefficient conventions [def-pur-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. All schemes below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the small pro-etale derived categories and the derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the compact-support functors [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and their constructible exceptional adjoints [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Write $\otimes$ for $\otimes_A^L$.

Let $f:V\to S$ be separated finite type and let $b:S'\to S$ be a $k$-morphism. Form $V'=V\times_SS'$ with projections $a:V'\to V$ and $f':V'\to S'$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Put $\omega_f=Rf^!A_S$ and $\omega_{f'}=Rf'^!A_{S'}$. For bounded constructible inputs use the exchange isomorphism $C_M:Lb^*Rf_!M\to Rf'_!La^*M$ of [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale] and the actual exceptional Hom bijections [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. Let $B:La^*\omega_f\to\omega_{f'}$ be the transpose of $Lb^*\varepsilon_{f,A_S}\circ C_{\omega_f}^{-1}$, followed by $Lb^*A_S\cong A_{S'}$, with the dualizing base-change convention of [def-pur-co-smoothness].

Let $L\in D^b_c(V,A)$ and $t:Rf_!L\to A_S$, and let $P:L\to\omega_f$ be its adjoint transpose. Suppose $t':Rf'_!La^*L\to A_{S'}$ satisfies $t'\circ C_L=Lb^*t$, with the unit comparison understood. Then its transpose is
$$P'=B\circ La^*P.$$
No smoothness or choice of an identification of either dualizing object with a Tate twist is assumed.
